summary: Connect project creation (quick and AI-guided) to the model: the owner approved the project_guidance operation, so harness/budget.json sets owner_approved=true and the gateway no longer forces local mode. Also fixes the malformed JSON example in the guidance system prompt and updates the tests that asserted the unapproved state.

budget_impact.rationale: project_guidance becomes callable: one request per interactive guidance turn, at most six turns per session, each capped at 1200 input / 500 output tokens and subject to the global daily/monthly ceilings. No key, AI switch off, ceiling hit, network error or malformed reply still degrade to local mode with no retry and no fallback model.
budget_impact.before: Every guidance turn was refused at the gateway (operation awaiting owner approval); 0 model tokens.
budget_impact.after: Up to 6 turns per session, reference 800 in / 300 out per turn, cap 1200 in / 500 out; measured usage unknown (no live call was made).

quantified.period: one project-guidance session, max six interactive turns

checks.note: 341 tests passed, run outside the sandbox so HTTP tests could bind a local port.

reviews.note: Critical change: independent review is still required before release.

open_risks: No live DeepSeek call was made: answer quality, latency and real token use for project_guidance are unmeasured.
The creation page still says quick creation is local-first and does not show why a turn degraded.
Release approval and independent review are pending.
